changes: Authenticated pause(true) and disconnect bypass the slow HTTP operation lock; resume/configuration retain serialization.
Disconnect invalidates pending connection attempts, including a delayed credential read or adapter connection.
Core pending-pause flag participates in status and transport authorization. Image upload completion rechecks authorization before message send.
MCP stdio integration tests use an ephemeral loopback port injected only by trusted test code. Public schemas and production default endpoint are unchanged.
WorkBuddy sender tests follow documented 2.3.1 semantics: each explicit invocation gets a fresh request ID; a timeout never causes an automatic retry.
Updated current configuration and routing documentation while retaining dated historical evidence.
Initialized workspace Git with credentials, state, browser sessions, backups, previews, collected samples and release archives excluded.
remaining_validation: Long-running morning delivery, sleep/resume and extended inactivity require separate real runtime evidence.
Standalone BUAA crawler browser authentication and integration with QQ remain untested and unimplemented respectively.
